fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (INTC) stock price declined over 20% in the past month; amid semiconductor sector recovery, Q3 results guidance shows revenue target of $1.65 billion and EPS of $0.40, with PC chip sales expected at $880 million and data center at $660 million.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix eased AI trade concerns with strong results (revenue $7.87 billion, 632% increase); Intel foundry business is expected to generate $610 million in revenue (44% year-over-year increase) as customer wins from Google, Nvidia and others progress.
fields.summary_ko.2: Intel is expanding manufacturing capacity through increased capital expenditure; negotiations are underway with SK Hynix for Ohio manufacturing facility leasing; amid PC industry weakness, memory and storage price increases are driving higher average selling prices, though sales volumes decline.
